title: Inside the Ancient God
summary: Following the floating pumice of the Chaotic Broken Stars, the group reaches the entrance to the first trial, inside the body of an ancient god so huge that a single hair passage could dwarf a planet. Duanmu Ji explains that they have come for the Infant Transformation Pill. The ancient god's consciousness only sleeps, and whoever enters its body may take the techniques stored in its memory. When a desolate beast attacks and the devils scatter, Wang Lin realises it is only a parasite living inside a dead beast's corpse, so he slips into its belly, kills it and takes its marrow, which Li Muwan said was the real treasure. Crossing a few hundred feet of void filled with clever alien creatures takes him fifteen days and uses up all his magic treasures. At the last crack he survives with the formation from Li Muwan's jade slip. At the sealed entrance ordinary spirit stones do nothing, so he forces his way in.
events: The devils follow the pumice to the first trial inside the ancient god's body
Duanmu Ji reveals the goals: the Infant Transformation Pill and the ancient god's memories
A desolate beast attacks and the devils scatter
Wang Lin sees the beast is a parasite in a corpse, kills it from inside and takes its marrow
Clever void creatures force him into a fifteen-day crossing that uses up his treasures
Li Muwan's jade-slip formation saves him at the last crack
Spirit stones fail at the entrance, so he breaks in
cultivation: Duanmu Ji is at mid Soul Formation; the desolate beast is at Soul Formation great perfection.
